biography.value: Shadow Lurkers hunt from above. They use Ceiling Stalker to position on ceilings or high walls, drop onto targets from advantage, and drain Current Luck — which degrades save capability in a way that compounds across the encounter. A target who has taken three hits from a Shadow Lurker is functionally unable to resist saves effectively for the rest of the session. A summoner who calls one to soften a high-priority target before a difficult encounter, or to reduce a spellcaster's save capability during a negotiation that might turn hostile, will find it performs that specific function cleanly. It will not tell the summoner what it has learned about the environment from its ceiling vantage. A summoner who asks will get an accurate answer.

system.attacksNotes:
Shadow Claw [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 2), Reach: 5 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 6 damage (4 + 2 Str) + 2 Negative damage (Half DR); target's Current Luck reduced by 1.
  • Margin 2: 6 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 2; target gains Disoriented condition until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 6 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 3; Disoriented; target makes Will [Easy] save or Frightened until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Amorphous: Can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. Shadow Form: While in dim light or darkness, DR increases to 6 against all non-magical damage and non-Positive energy damage. Positive energy ignores this entirely. Ceiling Stalker: Can move across ceilings and vertical surfaces without Athletics checks. When attacking from above, subtract 1 from both attack dice.
